verdict.rationale: The product is itself the official Agent SDK, with extensive first-party docs covering Python/TypeScript APIs, tools, hooks, subagents, MCP, permissions, sessions, structured outputs, and production hosting guidance, directly satisfying the 'build against official SDKs' story. Community commentary reflects DX/harness and policy-clarity complaints rather than evidence the SDK fails to function as an official build target. Missing for 10: independent hands-on production case studies fully corroborating claimed capabilities and resolving the harness/observability complaints noted by developers.
